lecturers.title: Lecturer
lecturers.subtitle: Meet our expert teaching staff who are highly dedicated to the development of Arabic language education through teaching, research, and community service.

curriculum.title: Transformation of
curriculum.subtitle: PBA FITK UIN Syarif Hidayatullah Jakarta is committed to improving quality through an innovative, integrative, and applicable curriculum in line with global dynamics.

digital_era.title: Digital Era & Innovation
digital_era.desc: Changes in the global educational landscape demand learning that is not only theoretical but also utilizes digital technology to create graduates who are adaptive, creative, and problem-solvers in the 21st century.

holistic_vision.title: Holistic-Integrative Vision
holistic_vision.desc: An authentic task-based and holistic approach is the new foundation. We are updating conventional structures into an inclusive and future-oriented educational ecosystem.

obe.title: Outcome Based Education (OBE)
obe.desc: We adopt the OBE framework to ensure the entire educational process is directed towards achieving measurable graduate competencies oriented toward real-world outcomes.

curriculum.quote: Creating an Arabic language education ecosystem that is more dynamic, inclusive, and future-oriented as a contribution to the academic reputation of UIN Jakarta.

cpl.title: Graduate
cpl.subtitle: The PBA FITK UIN Jakarta curriculum is designed to ensure every graduate meets global competency standards covering aspects of attitude, knowledge, and skills.
cpl.cefr_desc: Graduates are required to have minimum language proficiency at the B1 level (Intermediate) as an international competency standard.

0.title: Ethics & Integrity
0.desc: Analyze, internalize, and demonstrate piety, professional responsibility, and ethics in diversity and social-environmental care for integrated decision-making.

1.title: Language Proficiency (CEFR B1)
1.desc: Use Arabic receptively, productively, interactively, and meditatively with a minimum proficiency equivalent to CEFR B1 (Lower Intermediate) in various communication contexts.

2.title: Arabic Linguistics & Literature
2.desc: Master and apply basic concepts of Arabic linguistics and literature, referring to relevant international references in linguistic analysis.

3.title: Innovative Learning Principles
3.desc: Analyze and evaluate language learning principles to design and adapt innovative strategies based on current technology.

4.title: Learning Technology
4.desc: Design, implement, and evaluate technology-based Arabic language learning in an innovative and adaptive manner.

5.title: Research Methodology
5.desc: Design and conduct Arabic language education research based on scientific methods and disseminate results according to global standards.

6.title: Language-Based Edupreneur
6.desc: Develop Arabic language-based edupreneur competencies with innovative managerial strategies in global-oriented creative industries.
